translations.web: For, “His letters”, they say, “are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech is despised.”
translations.bsb: For some say, “His letters are weighty and forceful, but his physical presence is unimpressive, and his speaking is of no account.”
translations.kjv: For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible.
translations.asv: For, His letters, they say, are weighty and strong; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech of no account.
